rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for perceiving a sound or finding out information.

example.english: I hear someone calling me at the door.
example.traditional: 我聽到有人喺門口叫我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 dou2 jau5 jan4 hai2 mun4 hau2 giu3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for intentionally listening, or for heeding a request as in 聽佢話.

rows.jyutping: sau1 dou2 A ge3 siu1 sik1
rows.note: Use this when someone has contacted you and you have received news from them.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 dou2 aa3 maa1 ge3 siu1 sik1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for understanding and sympathizing with someone's feelings or point of view, as in 我明白你.

example.english: I hear you; I understand why you are so angry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 nau1
